_what: Segal 2.3 coverage register: for every package the tree contains, either the per-mechanism PRD that specifies it, or the recorded reason it needs none.
_read_by: scripts/submission_mechanisms.py -- the inventory is walked from git ls-files, NOT from this file. An entry here answers for a package; it can never invent one.
_rules: An entry passes when `prds` is non-empty and every path in it is tracked and NOT superseded, or when `reason` is non-empty. A package the walk finds and this file does not answer for is a GAP. An entry naming a package the walk does not find is a GAP too.

src/pursuit/gui.note: CLOSED by 08-08. docs/PRD_display_belief.md is deliberately NOT cited: it governs what a view may CONTAIN (rules 8-9), not how the seven gui/ files render or replay, and citing it here would close this row with a document that answers a different question.

src/pursuit/network.note: The FastMCP peer layer. The tunnel is explicitly OUT of this PRD's scope (docs/PRD_mcp_transport.md:28) and is specified by docs/PRD_tunnel.md instead; the G1-M-TUNNEL row derives that exclusion from the transport PRD's own text rather than trusting this note.

src/pursuit/sdk.note: CLOSED by 08-08. The SDK layer is Table 5's first row and Segal 4's mandated single entry point. Its PRD covers both halves of the package -- the game rules as callable functions, and the rules 8-9 read model -- and records the limit honestly: nothing automated stops a FUTURE rule being written into network/.

src/pursuit/services.reason: Umbrella package. Every mechanism under it lives in a child package that carries its own entry in this register (services/llm, services/reporting); nothing at this level is a mechanism in its own right.

src/pursuit/services/llm.note: gatekeeper.py and gatekeeper_types.py live here, so both PRDs are cited.

src/pursuit/services/reporting.note: The declaration_ artifact's wrapper is specified inside PRD_end_of_game.md's artifact set but has no production caller yet -- registered separately in docs/SUBMISSION-CHECKLIST.md and owned by 08-04.

src/pursuit/shared.reason: Cross-cutting configuration loaders, frozen value objects and version.py -- not a mechanism. Every number it loads is specified in the PRD of the mechanism that consumes it (belief_config -> PRD_belief_map, scent_config -> PRD_scent_map, gatekeeper_params -> PRD_gatekeeper, tunnel_config -> PRD_tunnel, display_config -> PRD_display_belief).

src/pursuit/strategy.note: docs/PRD_rl_strategy.md is deliberately NOT cited: it is superseded, and the resolver refuses a superseded PRD as coverage.

src/pursuit/strategy/graph.reason: Graph primitives (connected components, cycle rank, territory) consumed by the matrix mover's evaluation weights; their contract is specified inside docs/PRD_matrix_mover.md rather than in a PRD of their own.
